title: 2013 AMC 8 Problem 18
statement: Isabella uses one-foot cubical blocks to build a rectangular fort that is \(12\) feet long, \(10\) feet wide, and \(5\) feet high. The floor and the four walls are all one foot thick. How many blocks does the fort contain?

solutions.text:
The rectangular prism determined by the outside faces has volume \(12\cdot10\cdot5=600\) cubic feet. The empty inside is smaller by \(2\) feet in length, \(2\) feet in width, and \(1\) foot in height, so its dimensions are \(10\times8\times4\).

The empty volume is \(10\cdot8\cdot4=320\) cubic feet, so the fort contains \(600-320=280\) one-foot cubical blocks.

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Subtract the empty inside volume from the outside rectangular prism.
The inside dimensions are reduced by two feet in length/width and one foot in height.
